scope: Shared static self-grant core checkpoint only. Ms. Marvel has a real typed gated producer; her complete flag remains false. Iron Fist is unchanged and gated. Armor consumer is authored separately.

api.identity: Exact recipient incarnation and frozen granting definition; stable acquisition timestamp, independent of copies, controller changes and generated static chronology.
api.layer6: Separate GrantSelf marker, distinct from old indexed trigger/activation grants; later removal removes the instance, and leaving removal restores the old instance.
api.layer7b: ControllerHandPower dynamically uses current recipient controller hand count in actual and speculative worlds; it is not a CDA (CR604.3a).
api.layer7c: ControllerArtifactBonus dynamically counts current recipe-effective controlled artifacts, including the recipient and artifact lands; independent grants stack.
api.chronology: effect_timestamp follows physical transform/reattach CR613.7a, preserving relative static order without reacquiring the layer6 ability.
api.expiry: Exact source departure removes rows; all cleanup paths clear EOT grants before cleanup SBA.
api.new_public_payload: Optional Observation.self_granted_abilities; omitted when absent, with typed kind, availability and both timestamps.

qualifications: Gated Marvel fixture substitutes only her actual physical definition in Hand, then uses ordinary checked paid actions. This is not an accepted-pool deck construction claim.
ControllerArtifactBonus is exercised through an explicitly bounded helper consuming a real frozen Marvel trigger packet; no whole Armor acceptance is claimed.
Physical retimestamp uses an explicitly bounded existing primitive; it does not claim that a creature may equip or a single-faced Marvel may transform.
Actual paid casts, removal Aura/Disenchant, copied values, ownership/privacy and raw/index restore surround the focused core boundaries.
deferred: No admissions, new IDs, old trace export/rebaseline, all-native/default, full static, release, CI or aggregate validation in this checkpoint.
